title: Search product by keyword returns relevant results
description: Verify the search engine returns products matching the keyword in title or description.
preconditions: Product catalog contains at least 50 active listings.

steps.action: Navigate to the homepage and type 'wireless headphones' in the search bar.
steps.expectedResult: Search results page loads with relevant products.

steps.action: Verify at least one result contains the keyword in title or description.
steps.expectedResult: Products contain 'wireless' or 'headphones' in their metadata.

title: Filter products by category and price range
description: Verify the filter panel correctly narrows results by category and price.
preconditions: Product catalog has items across multiple categories and price points.

steps.action: Apply the 'Electronics' category filter and set price range $50–$200.
steps.expectedResult: Only electronics products priced $50–$200 are shown.

steps.action: Verify the results count updates after each filter change.
steps.expectedResult: Result count reflects the active filter combination.

title: Product detail page displays correct information
description: Verify all product details (title, price, SKU, images, ratings) render correctly.
preconditions: A published product with at least 3 images and 5 reviews exists.

steps.action: Click on a product from the search results.
steps.expectedResult: Product detail page loads with title, price, and images.

steps.action: Verify the image gallery cycles through all images.
steps.expectedResult: All product images are navigable.

steps.action: Check the rating section shows the average score.
steps.expectedResult: Star rating and review count are displayed correctly.

title: Out-of-stock product shows unavailable state
description: Verify products with zero inventory display the correct unavailable status.
preconditions: A product exists with stock quantity = 0.

steps.action: Open the detail page of an out-of-stock product.
steps.expectedResult: 'Out of Stock' badge is shown; Add to Cart button is disabled.

steps.action: Verify the 'Notify Me' option is available.
steps.expectedResult: Email notification signup form is displayed.

title: Product image gallery loads without broken images
description: Verify all images in the gallery load correctly with no broken image placeholders.
preconditions: Product has at least 3 associated images stored in the CDN.

steps.action: Open a product detail page.
steps.expectedResult: Primary image renders without error.

steps.action: Click through all thumbnail images.
steps.expectedResult: Each image loads correctly; no broken image icon appears.

title: Add item to cart from product detail page
description: Verify the add-to-cart action updates the cart count and persists the item.
preconditions: User is logged in; product is in stock.

steps.action: Click 'Add to Cart' on a product detail page.
steps.expectedResult: Cart icon count increments by 1; success toast is shown.

steps.action: Open the cart.
steps.expectedResult: The added product appears with correct name, price, and quantity 1.

title: Update item quantity in cart
description: Verify users can increase or decrease the quantity of items already in the cart.
preconditions: Cart contains at least one item.

steps.action: Open cart and increase item quantity to 3.
steps.expectedResult: Subtotal updates to reflect 3× the unit price.

steps.action: Decrease quantity back to 1.
steps.expectedResult: Subtotal recalculates correctly.

title: Remove item from cart
description: Verify the remove action correctly deletes the item and updates the cart total.
preconditions: Cart contains at least two items.

steps.action: Click the remove icon for one item.
steps.expectedResult: Item is removed from cart; cart total decreases accordingly.

steps.action: Verify cart header count updates.
steps.expectedResult: Cart icon count decrements by the removed item's quantity.

title: Apply valid discount coupon reduces order total
description: Verify a valid coupon code is accepted and the discount is applied correctly.
preconditions: Active coupon code 'SAVE20' gives 20% off orders above $50.

steps.action: Add a $60 item to cart and proceed to checkout.
steps.expectedResult: Order summary shows $60 subtotal.

steps.action: Enter coupon code 'SAVE20' and apply.
steps.expectedResult: Discount of $12.00 (20%) is shown; total becomes $48.00.

title: Expired coupon code shows error message
description: Verify that entering an expired coupon surfaces a helpful error message.
preconditions: Coupon code 'EXPIRED10' is past its expiry date.

steps.action: Enter coupon code 'EXPIRED10' in the promo field.
steps.expectedResult: Error: 'This coupon has expired.'

steps.action: Verify the order total remains unchanged.
steps.expectedResult: No discount is applied to the order.

title: Checkout completes with saved credit card
description: Verify the full checkout flow using a previously saved payment method.
preconditions: User has a saved Visa card on file.

steps.action: Proceed through checkout and select the saved card.
steps.expectedResult: Saved card is shown with masked number.

steps.action: Click Place Order.
steps.expectedResult: Order confirmation page loads with order ID.

steps.action: Verify order appears in order history.
steps.expectedResult: Order status is 'Processing' in order history.

title: Checkout with new credit card and 3DS authentication
description: Verify adding a new card during checkout triggers 3D Secure and completes the order.
preconditions: Test card with 3DS challenge is available in the test gateway.

steps.action: Enter new card details at checkout.
steps.expectedResult: 3DS challenge popup appears.

steps.action: Complete the 3DS challenge.
steps.expectedResult: Payment is authorised; order confirmation is shown.

title: Order confirmation email is sent after successful checkout
description: Verify the transactional email is sent to the customer with correct order details.
preconditions: Email service is connected to the test inbox.

steps.action: Complete a checkout.
steps.expectedResult: Order is created.

steps.action: Check the test inbox for the confirmation email.
steps.expectedResult: Email arrives within 1 minute with the correct order ID and total.

title: Order status updates in real time after dispatch
description: Verify that the order status progresses from Processing → Dispatched → Delivered.
preconditions: Order is in Processing state.

steps.action: Trigger dispatch event via the admin panel.
steps.expectedResult: Order status changes to 'Dispatched' and tracking number is assigned.

steps.action: Verify status update is reflected on the customer order page.
steps.expectedResult: Customer sees 'Dispatched' status without page refresh.

title: Return merchandise authorisation (RMA) request
description: Verify customers can submit an RMA request for a delivered order.
preconditions: Order is in 'Delivered' status and within the 30-day return window.

steps.action: Open the order and click 'Request Return'.
steps.expectedResult: RMA form is displayed.

steps.action: Select a return reason and submit.
steps.expectedResult: RMA is created with status 'Pending Approval'; email confirmation is sent.

title: Refund is processed within SLA after RMA approval
description: Verify the refund is issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.
preconditions: RMA is approved.

steps.action: Approve the RMA in the admin panel.
steps.expectedResult: Refund is queued in the payment gateway.

steps.action: Verify order status changes to 'Refunded'.
steps.expectedResult: Order status is 'Refunded'; customer receives confirmation email.

title: User registration and email verification
description: Verify new user sign-up flow including email verification before account activation.
preconditions: Email address not already registered.

steps.action: Complete the registration form with valid details.
steps.expectedResult: Account created; verification email is sent.

steps.action: Click the verification link in the email.
steps.expectedResult: Account is activated; user is redirected to the dashboard.

title: Update default shipping address
description: Verify users can add and set a new default shipping address.
preconditions: User is logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to Profile > Addresses and add a new address.
steps.expectedResult: New address is saved.

steps.action: Mark the new address as default.
steps.expectedResult: Default badge moves to the new address.

title: View order history lists all past orders
description: Verify the order history page correctly displays all completed orders with key details.
preconditions: User has at least 3 past orders.

steps.action: Navigate to Profile > Orders.
steps.expectedResult: Order history list is displayed.

steps.action: Verify each order shows order ID, date, total, and status.
steps.expectedResult: All required fields are present for each order.

title: Delete account removes personal data per GDPR
description: Verify account deletion anonymises personal data and prevents re-login.
preconditions: User has no open orders.

steps.action: Navigate to Account Settings > Delete Account and confirm.
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation email sent; account scheduled for deletion.

steps.action: After deletion, attempt to log in with the same credentials.
steps.expectedResult: Login fails with 'Account not found' message.

steps.action: Verify the user record is anonymised in the database.
steps.expectedResult: PII fields are replaced with anonymised values.
